x: His greatest rivals for places in the Scottish team will be Bill Sutherland (Highgate H.) and Alan Buchanan (Brighton & Hove A.C.). In 1967 Len Duquemin won the Southern 'Garnet' 10 Miles Championship and lead Sarnia Walking Club from Guernsey to success in the team championship.

In a 3km event over at Parliament Hill on June 25th, Carl Lawton clocked 13:16 in 2nd place behind A.Buchanan of Brighton and Hove (13:04). M.Yates was timed at 14:28 for 8th and R.Day 15:42 for 14th places.

Although John Hall, Ray Middleton and John Dunsford fought hard in the last race the 5,000 metres to close the gap, Brighton's Scottish International Alan Buchanan kept his club in first place by winning the race.
It was started by an active walker, the late Alf. MacSweeney (Highgate H) and the present Editor, Alan Buchanan (Brighton & Hove AC) is still very much an active walker.
